finding.claim: IDOR / missing authorization: /invoice/<inv_id> returns any invoice to any caller with no authentication or ownership check, unlike the sibling /my/invoice route which compares inv['customer'] to g.user['id'].
finding.source: inv_id path parameter from any unauthenticated or any-user HTTP request
finding.sink: jsonify(inv) returning the full invoice record from INVOICES

trace.note: route /invoice/<inv_id> registered with no auth decorator
INVOICES.get(inv_id) fetches record by attacker-supplied id, no owner check

finding.guards_checked: No before_request/login decorator or g.user check in the file; the ownership check present at line 16 for /my/invoice is absent here; no other middleware defined in the codebase (single file).

verdict.reason: invoices.py:7-10 registers /invoice/<inv_id> with no auth decorator, before_request hook, or owner check, and returns INVOICES.get(inv_id) as JSON, while the sibling route at invoices.py:16 does compare inv["customer"] to g.user["id"].
